## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the related issue.

## Validation

List checks you actually ran and their results. Note any checks not run.
For UI changes, attach screenshots using synthetic data.

## Review notes

Mention migrations, environment changes, compatibility or license implications.

- [ ] No credentials, private documents or real student data are included.
- [ ] Relevant tests/docs are updated, or an explanation is provided.
- [ ] Existing component licenses and notices are preserved.
